about: The Workbench icons of the PengPong drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/pengpong.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a black court with a blue bar along its top, a red paddle at each side, an orange ball and a penguin peeking up) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/pengpong.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. PengPong-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, PengPong.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's PengPong.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for README-PengPong.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the Data drawer's icon.
